name: Body and Mind
body:
School transmutation; Level paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You fuse body and mind into a perfect fighting whole. While this spell is in effect, you add your Constitution bonus in addition to your Wisdom modifier as a bonus on all Will saves, and add your Wisdom bonus to all melee damage rolls.
